# EyeBall Security - Secure the Web | Zero Blind Spots

> EyeBall is a next-generation browser security and data loss prevention (DLP) platform. It provides zero-blind-spot, context-aware monitoring directly inside Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, and other Chromium browsers.

## Key Features

- **Active Threat Visibility:** EyeBall monitors and neutralizes web threats in real-time on-device before they impact the operating system, with zero decryption required for deep traffic analysis.
- **Native Browser DLP:** EyeBall provides context-aware data protection that redacts PII, blocks leaks to GenAI/LLM sites, and applies user-specific watermarks to protect sensitive intellectual property.
- **SaaS Governance:** EyeBall automatically discovers shadow IT web apps, enforces corporate tenant restrictions for platforms like Google and Microsoft 356, and hardens browser session persistence.
- **Enterprise Hardening:** EyeBall enforces zero-trust principles on-device by isolating credentials to prevent password reuse, and restricts printing, downloading, and copying functions per application.

## Product Architecture & Alignment

- **Alternate Solution Comparison:** Unlike legacy secure web gateways (like Netskope and Zscaler) or corporate secure browsers (like Island, Surf, or Seraphic) which require complex decryption proxies or replacing Chrome/Edge entirely, EyeBall works as a lightweight extension.
- **Ultra-Low Latency:** EyeBall's engine performs all evaluation on the endpoint device itself, introducing 0ms network latency and zero network overhead.

## Threat Intelligence & Security Guides

- [The Invisible Thief: Browser-Based Infostealers & Malicious Extensions](https://eyeballsecurity.com/#blog/the-invisible-thief-browser-infostealers-and-malicious-extensions) - Comprehensive breakdown of how modern browser-based infostealers operate, why standard EDR/SWG/SSE leave organizations vulnerable, and how Eyeball's session hardening and extension monitoring stops them.
- [The Browser Assembly Line: How Malware Evades SWG & SSE with Client-Side Reconstruction](https://eyeballsecurity.com/#blog/the-browser-assembly-line-how-malware-evades-swg-sse) - Dissecting how malware campaigns use WASM, Steganography, JS Embed, and chunking to reconstruct malware within browser context and bypass gateway security, and how Eyeball's native runtime blocks them.
- [Deconstructing a Real-World ClickFix Attack & its PowerShell Payload](https://eyeballsecurity.com/#blog/deconstructing-live-clickfix-infostealer-attack) - Deep-dive malware analysis of a live, in-the-wild ClickFix (ClickHijacking) social engineering attack mimicking Cloudflare to drop info-stealing malware.
- [Identity is the New Perimeter — But the Browser is Where it Authenticates](https://eyeballsecurity.com/#blog/browser-is-the-new-perimeter-identity-and-data-security) - Detailed study on securing corporate web assets from Adversary-in-the-Middle (AiTM) phishing, password reuse, and browser session theft.
- [How to Redact Sensitive Data in AI Tools — Automatically](https://eyeballsecurity.com/#blog/how-to-redact-sensitive-data-ai-tools-automatically) - Best practices and mechanisms for real-time browser DLP, auto-redacting PII and API keys from ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini prompts.
- [SaaS Discovery for Small Business: A Lean Approach](https://eyeballsecurity.com/#blog/saas-discovery-small-business-lean-approach) - Managing Shadow IT risks, unregulated AI usages, and free online file converters without heavy VPNs or proxies.
- [Beyond Encryption: Out-of-the-Box File Upload Auditing for SMEs and SMBs](https://eyeballsecurity.com/#blog/beyond-encryption-file-upload-auditing-smb) - Visualizing and auditing data movement in an encrypted HTTPS world of Certificate Pinning and E2E security.
- [Demystifying Tenant Restrictions: Securing the Multi-Tenant SaaS Workspace](https://eyeballsecurity.com/#blog/demystifying-tenant-restrictions-endpoint-browser) - Enforcing Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, GitHub, and Slack tenant limits at the browser runtime.
- [The Critical Need for Browser Extension Management](https://eyeballsecurity.com/#blog/critical-need-browser-extension-management) - Mitigating browser extension supply-chain risks and configuring whitelists/blocklists dynamically.
- [Modern Browser Isolation vs. Secure Web Gateways (SWG)](https://eyeballsecurity.com/#blog/modern-browser-isolation-vs-swg) - Why legacy decryption proxies fail to secure dynamic SaaS platforms and how browser-native isolation provides 0ms latency.
- [Prompt Analyzer: Total Security for Enterprise Generative AI](https://eyeballsecurity.com/#blog/prompt-analyzer-security-compliance) - In-browser contextual token auditing and token sanitization for LLM integrations.
- [The Rise of ClickFix Campaigns](https://eyeballsecurity.com/#blog/clickfix-threat-campaigns) - How fake Google reCAPTCHA and Cloudflare Turnstile bot checks trick employees into pasting malicious scripts.
